title: cfs values
description: A people-and-values section: a big light title, a large team photo with a navy quote card overlapping its right side (orange left rule, an orange quote mark, a centred light quote, a short orange vertical rule, monospace name and role), then four values in columns (monospace label over a small paragraph indented behind a hairline) and a ring-arrow link. On phones the photo runs edge to edge and the card overlaps its bottom with an orange top rule.
notes: the quote card is a `dark` subtree on the theme's card colour (navy in cfs-theme)
one media slot: the team photo (about 1.12:1 on wide screens, 0.92:1 on phones)
